persons.name: Mohanajibhahālajamiṭhālaha
persons.evidence: mohanajibhahālajamiṭhālahena svārthaṃ paropakārārthaṃ ... pustakaṃ yal likhitaṃ

notes: The scribe's name is a single instrumental compound (-ena) and is probably corrupt or a vernacular (Hindi/Gujarati/Marwari) name. One possible segmentation is Mohanajī + bhahā(?) + lālaja (born of Lāla?) + Miṭhālā(la), with miṭhālahena perhaps an error for miṭhālālena. This would make the scribe one Mīṭhālāla, possibly identified through Mohanajī or Lāla(jī), but the segmentation is uncertain, so the full string is kept as the name. The year is given only as the Jovian saṃvatsara Kṣaya, without a numbered era. Under southern reckoning, Pauṣa of a Kṣaya year falls around Dec–Jan 1866/67, 1926/27, and so on (1986/87 is too late for this collection), so ce_approx is left empty. The book was copied at Kāśī, not in Nepal. Both svārthaṃ and paropakārārthaṃ are stated, so the scribe is treated as both scribe and owner.
